text.en: Clients frequently praise Sherry, Martha, and Kayla for their friendly approach and professional attentiveness on West Road. Reviewers note that groomers listen carefully to specific requests, though one puppy owner experienced poor communication when addressing a haircut complaint.

title.en: Patient care for dogs and cats

text.en: Reviewers emphasize how comfortably animals are handled, noting that groomers remain remarkably calm and tolerant with difficult mini schnauzers and big dogs alike. Clients also appreciate the gentle touch provided for regular Persian cat lion cuts and senior pet eye trims.

title.en: Quality styling with facial cut dispute

text.en: Most pet parents report great grooming results, including clean lion cuts for cats, neat nail trims, and well-maintained coats. However, one reviewer was severely disappointed by an unexpected facial trim on a puppy that removed her teddy bear appearance without owner consent.

q.en: Do they provide cat grooming services?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently mention bringing long-haired Persian cats for lion haircuts and bath styling.

q.en: Are groomers experienced with anxious or energetic dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients note that groomers like Martha are patient and skilled at calming fussy schnauzers and large dogs.

q.en: Does the facility provide pet boarding and daycare?

a.en: Yes, Pet Styling by Sherry offers pet boarding and doggy daycare alongside grooming on West Road.
